property_summary: Reference C only accepts fallback calls that send exactly 10 ether (calls with other msg.value revert); the mutant accepts msg.value >= 10 ether so some calls with msg.value != 10 ether that the reference rejects will succeed in the mutant, leading to different post-call pastBlockTime behavior.
change_summary: Change the required incoming value from exactly 10 ether to at least 10 ether (>=) which alters when the fallback proceeds and thus can change pastBlockTime.
